files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

Planned fare changes (30 rows, one per affected station): station_code (refers to stations.csv; four digits with leading zeros), effective_from (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD), new_base_fare (two decimals; about 3% empty).

task_text: Using fare_changes.csv, count how many trips started at a station with a planned fare change, separately for each planned new_base_fare value; leave out stations whose planned fare is empty. `result` should be a Series indexed by new_base_fare.
intended_computation: Read trips.csv and fare_changes.csv (station codes as text), drop fare changes with an empty new_base_fare, match each trip's start_station to a fare change's station_code, and count matched trips per new_base_fare value; a Series indexed by new_base_fare.

acceptable_variants.notes: new_base_fare labels may be text such as 1.50; fare values without trips may be shown with 0

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
